desc: Derive the closed-form formula m * C(n-1, k) * (m-1)^(n-1-k) (reasoning confirmed in ideation).

Implement countGoodArrays: precompute fact/inv_fact up to n-1 in O(n) using one Fermat inverse plus downward pass; compute comb = fact[n-1] * inv_fact[k] % MOD * inv_fact[n-1-k] % MOD; return m % MOD * comb % MOD * pow(m-1, n-1-k, MOD) % MOD.

Verify correctness by hand against the three examples (4, 6, 2) and edge cases: n=1,k=0 → m; m=1,k=n-1 → 1; m=1,k<n-1 → 0 via pow(0, positive, MOD)=0 and pow(0,0,MOD)=1; O(n) time/space fine for n up to 1e5.
